errors.meaning: A batch stopped during execution; data.items says which items ran
errors.fix: Fix the failed item and send it and the skipped items again

errors.meaning: A build step failed after the build started
errors.fix: Read the end line's error and the failed step's event, fix the project, build again

errors.meaning: A group or the bare tool was run without a command
errors.fix: Pick one of `expected`

errors.meaning: The --cursor was not printed by this command with these arguments
errors.fix: Start again without --cursor

errors.meaning: No deployment has this identifier
errors.fix: Use the deployment deploy start reported

errors.meaning: The deployment ran and failed; data.state is failed
errors.fix: Read the worker's log for the deployment, fix the cause and start a new deployment

errors.meaning: The deployment had not ended when --timeout passed
errors.fix: Wait again with the same command (meta.next)

errors.meaning: No environment has this name in acme.yaml
errors.fix: Use an environment acme.yaml declares

errors.meaning: A file to lint does not exist
errors.fix: Check the path, relative to the working directory

errors.meaning: A --input value differs from the same argument on the command line
errors.fix: Give the argument once

errors.meaning: --input cannot be read or framed, or a document fails the fragment schema
errors.fix: Fix the key `field` points at

errors.meaning: --input exceeds input.maxBytes
errors.fix: Send a smaller document

errors.meaning: A bug in acme
errors.fix: Report it with the command line and the message

errors.meaning: The lint ran and found problems; data.files lists them
errors.fix: Fix the problems data.files names and lint again

errors.meaning: No member has this number
errors.fix: List the members: acme member list --team <TEAM>

errors.meaning: The operation key was used before with other arguments
errors.fix: Use a new key, or repeat the first request's arguments

errors.meaning: No page has this slug
errors.fix: Check the page slug; it is the last part of the page's address

errors.meaning: The page store could not be reached when the command was to start
errors.fix: Try again; if it persists, check the store's address in acme.yaml

errors.meaning: The tag is reserved for the directory (admin, owner)
errors.fix: Choose another tag

errors.meaning: No team has this name
errors.fix: Check the team name

errors.meaning: A command word is not in the tree
errors.fix: Pick one of `expected`

errors.meaning: The command line does not parse or does not satisfy the command's requirements
errors.fix: Run acme schema <COMMAND> --json
